title: VHX
description: This mod adds more food that can be crafted from vanilla items in Minecraft.
body:
VHX (Vanila Harvest X) adds additional food to your game, crafted from vanilla items. If you want a more extensive food expansion for your Minecraft game, I recommend installing this mod! The mod also includes new crafting options for both craftable and furnace items. 
The game includes the following foods:
1. Cheese Pizza
2. Chocolate
3. Chocolate Ice Cream
4. Cheese
5. Lots of different donuts
6. Croutons
7. Croissant
8. Waffle
9. Pasta

And much more!
